series.name: HORROR GAMES
series.tagline: Playing games I am terrified of. Every single time.
series.description: I am overwhelmingly terrified of horror games, so join me alongside my journey through series like F.N.A.F., Poppy Playtime, Garten of Banban, and more! No fake reactions, ever.
series.why: Raw human reactions to genuine terror, alongside a loud and confident personality, bringing the viewer into a game of interest and keeping them in with constant stimulation and engagement.

series.name: GAME CHALLENGES
series.tagline: Spin the Wheels, Push Up Fades, Dares, you name it, I do it!
series.description: Playing games of challenge, and failure or setbacks punish me.
series.why: Viewers love watching drama and energy. Punishments and challenges allow me to do just that.

series.name: ROMANTICIZING LIFE
series.tagline: My raw life vlog series featuring vacations, solo trips, and journies of all sorts.
series.description: Bringing my camera with me no matter where I go. Combining my energetic spirit, outgoing and extroverted nature, and the lack of limitations to what I will do.
series.why: Life is full of problems, full of drama, full of negatives. It's a great change of pace to step back and enjoy life. Some viewers may not be able to experience what I can, or have the confidence in themself to do so. This allows for my content to stand out as the viewer is able to live vicariously through me.

series.name: VIEWER RECOMMENDED
series.tagline: You pick it. I play it.
series.description: My chat is always open to suggestions. All comments, chats, and messages are read and added to a list, and played for your entertainment!
series.why: A small, personal, intimate style channel is what I intend to harbor. Allowing viewers to steer the wheel as I drive allows for an engaging and dynamic content space.

programming.title: WORD ESCAPE
programming.description: My first installation of game development: a story-based puzzle game.
programming.concept: Word Escape is an escape room based game inspired by WORDLE that focuses on word input fields in order to manuever through each level to escape.
programming.build: Developed by Trevor Toland (Graphics) and Cameron Rydwell (Backend and Development) for the 'Computer Game & Simulation Programming' 2023 NLC Topic for Future Business Leaders of America
programming.proves: Games are the way of the future. Expanding off of new and existing ideas and spinning them into my own topic is crucial. Providing a unique concept, graphics, and level design, the player is able to immerse themself in an escape room-esque world.
awards: FBLA REGIONAL 1st Place - Computer Game & Programming Simulation
FBLA STATE 1st Place - Computer Game & Programming Simulation
Advanced to FBLA Nationals - Atlanta, GA

programming.title: STITCHED UP
programming.description: A dark narrative revolving around the concept of self-identity and depression.
programming.concept: Stitched Up is a narrative-driven psychological game centered around Silis, a 16-year-old boy caught in the quiet chaos of his own mind. At its core, the game is about identity, avoidance, and emotional deterioration, told through surreal, dreamlike sequences and emotionally driven choices.
programming.build: A Life Project surrounding the heavy topic of mental health and its expansive and no-punches-pulled nature. Featuring in house music, graphics, and a fully options-based storyline that changes at every fork in the road.
programming.proves: The story of many lives that is put into a playable world. I advocate for mental health wellness and have always struggled to tell my story and allow those interested in on the true world behind the affected. This game intends to do so.

programming.title: CAMRY.DEV
programming.description: Everything around who I am, what I can do, and where we can go.
programming.concept: A personalized and interactive portfolio that draws in those interested in all there is to do with me, and displays everything at their fingertips.
programming.build: A fully dynamic and easy to navigate website that separates every part of me. From personal, to professional, on screen, behind the screen. It's all on display at my will.
programming.proves: My creative visions and ambitions, taking one concept, such as a portfolio or resume, and combining it with my engineering skills and artistic touches to create a product of its own that's constantly developing and expanding. Features releasing regularly.
